message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.1.8 IS LIVE! (PREMIERE PRO)**

Version 2.1.8 makes the panel smoother and makes Auto Cut more reliable on slower machines.

*(Install over your current version with your ZXP installer and restart Premiere Pro once to apply the update.)*

♦️ **Smoother Panel**
* **Tab Switching:** Only the tab you open is redrawn now, instead of the whole panel.
* **No More Short Freezes:** Clicking back into Premiere Pro, or moving the mouse back onto the panel, no longer makes it hang for a moment.

♦️ **Auto Cut Fix**
* **Silences & Retakes Removed on Slower Machines:** Premiere can take several seconds to show new cuts on the timeline, and Auto Cut gave up after about 6 seconds, so the gaps stayed in. It now waits up to about 40 seconds. If the cuts still haven't appeared, it removes nothing and tells you, so one undo puts everything back.

♦️ **Coming From An Older Version?**
* This update also includes everything from 2.1.7: the redesigned Auto Captions tab and the Un-Nest fixes.
